raise_InstanceFrozenFieldError: raise InstanceFrozenFieldError to signal an attempt to modify an immutable field by name
raise_OutOfRangeHookError: raise OutOfRangeHookError when a value exceeds the configured min and max range bounds
raise_MissingRangeHookError: raise MissingRangeHookError when both min and max values are missing for a range hook
catch_InstanceBaseError: catch InstanceBaseError as a base exception to handle all instance-related errors in one block
catch_HookError: catch HookError as a base exception to handle all hook-related errors including range violations
